decisions.reason: As a flagship business unit closely tied to the firm's core vessel-management capabilities and future offshore-renewables positioning, it is likely to be retained despite moderate market uncertainty.
This service is complementary to the firm's existing crew and travel activities, so keeping it open is relatively low cost even though demand for travel-related services remains somewhat uncertain.
The online vessel information portal is a flagship digital offering with low incremental carrying costs and clear strategic fit with broader, higher-value client service.
The mobile vessel performance app supports efficiency and sustainability goals and is inexpensive to keep as an option, though it is less central than the firm's flagship launches.
